searchText: <@!552133098075193354> moving the call is fine! <@474322772806467600> miner_bribe would need to be bumped by 12.5%. Bumping base_fee doesn't actually mean you pay more, and for DoS protection we need the person to pay for replace by fee. You might also need to change `fee_cap`. For instance my first bid is 5 Gwei bribe, 10 Gwei max fee. I could replace the bribe to 6 Gwei, then 7 etc. even beyond 10 Gwei. Since the miner would get the minimum between the bribe and `fee_cap - basefee`, it doesn't matter if I replace the bribe to 11, 12, 13 etc. while fee cap is still at 10 (unless miners disregard transactions where bribe > fee cap?) Hmm, interesting point. No major objections, so I've moved the call to 15:00 UTC. Reminder, it's this **Thursday, 15:00 UTC** Agenda here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/209 Zoom link to be posted in this channel shortly prior to the call, and recording to be uploaded on YT afterwards. > You might also need to change `fee_cap`. For instance my first bid is 5 Gwei bribe, 10 Gwei max fee. I could replace the bribe to 6 Gwei, then 7 etc. even beyond 10 Gwei. Since the miner would get the minimum between the bribe and `fee_cap - basefee`, it doesn't matter if I replace the bribe to 11, 12, 13 etc. while fee cap is still at 10 (unless miners disregard transactions where bribe > fee cap?) <@!486501030046203915> Yes true so a replaceByFee tx would need to bump fee_cap as well as bribe?
